cookieConsent.title: About cookies
cookieConsent.description: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience, including basic features like saving your invite code. By continuing to use this site, you agree to our use of cookies.
cookieConsent.details: We use essential functional cookies (such as sign-in and invite code linking), plus one first-party cookie for aggregated visit and purchase-conversion stats; none are used for advertising. Click "Decline" or "Opt out of analytics" in the footer to opt out. You can also manage cookies in your browser settings at any time.
cookieConsent.detailsThirdParty: This site also uses a third-party web analytics service (Google Analytics), which sets its own cookies; you can block these cookies in your browser settings.
